parts.t: East Coquitlam is a spacious and family-oriented community on the city's eastern edge, offering larger lot sizes, access to Mundy Park, and a relaxed residential pace. It's an ideal area for buyers who want room to grow while staying connected to the broader Tri-Cities area.
